label: About AtomsAI
title: It started with a phone call. It didn't stop there.
intro: We started SaaS Labs in 2016 to make business communication simpler. Today our technology powers over a billion conversations a year. Each one showed us more to build.

blocks.title: A simpler way to talk
body: SaaS Labs began with one product: a simpler phone system for sales and support teams.

blocks.title: The whole stack
body: Applications, speech models, real-time infrastructure, and custom engineering, each one strengthening the others.

body: A decade in, we're taking on harder problems with the same belief that got us started.

sections.title: The real world had more to say
sections.label: What the calls taught us
intro: Three things kept coming up in the calls. Solving them took us beyond business software, into speech models, real-time infrastructure, and the intelligence that turns conversations into action.

blocks.title: People interrupt
body: Real conversations overlap, pause, and change direction mid-sentence.

blocks.title: Phone lines distort voices
body: Narrow audio, noise, and accents break models trained on clean speech.

blocks.title: Questions expect action
body: Customers ask the unexpected and expect something to happen next.

sections.title: One breakthrough made the next possible
intro: What we learn building one strengthens the others.
That’s how SaaS Labs grew into AtomsAI.
